title: [Solved] Test Play not working; errors with NW.js

posts.author: MateoAkoro
Andar
posts.body:
Please search the forum, this error and its solution has been posted several times.
basically you have a mixup in your nw.js versions, likely due to an update of either, and you need to go back to a very specific version of nw.js to solve this.
I just don't remember which version of it, that's why you have to look for the other posts.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
I got that error while playing other games and back to my project.
it can be safely ignored and restart as it should work right after that.
it can also happen if you did a game with newer version and try something
with the older version, but ignoring it just boot the game or by F5 or restart it
by reopening it.
as there is a tool to get rid of this, it get back in a while, but ignoring is the
best thing, if it keeps popping up and wont open the game/project, than
something else blocking it.

posts.body: I think I managed to fix this issue by updating the NW.js file to the most recent version. Error message and Play Test windows open now, but I'm being extremely cautious and backing everything up.
